name: The Sealed Line

frame.axes: +x is the direction of travel, +y up; the train is the fixed frame and the land moves under it

status: Not poured yet. The trough owns vehicles, and a train is a vehicle: it needs a rail service in the trough (a lane like the ferry's, stations as piers) before it can run there without a page load. Today the join is by door: every halt in line.json is a place in the overworld whose door boards the train, and getting off at a halt carries you back to that place.
note: Bees on a Train as a make-photo level: a locomotive and eight carriages you walk through, a camera rig of twenty-four positions and moves, thresholds onto worlds made from the El Desierto train clips, and seeds for world-model takes.
